notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Battered Golem using its Forest ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Battered Golem triggers, untapping it.
Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, triggering Amareth.
In response, activate Sensei's Divining Top's last ability by tapping it, drawing a card, then putting Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve Amareth's trigger, putting Sensei's Divining Top from your library into your hand.
Repeat.
